title: Business Proposal: After-Hours Auditing
macguffin: the confidential merger contract containing a fatal corporate loophole
intro: Ten minutes before the board signs off on a high-stakes multi-billion dollar acquisition, the physical master contract vanishes from the locked executive suite safe.
setting: A sleek, rain-slicked corporate skyscraper in Seoul after midnight. The biometric elevators have locked down due to a system breach, trapping the entire elite strategy team inside.
timeline: The contract was verified and placed in the executive safe before the board meeting adjourned.
A sudden power brownout triggered a thirty-second reset on the office floor's security cameras.
The executive safe registered a manual biometric override using an authorized managing director's credential.
The empty leather folio was discovered right as the CEO returned to sign the papers.

evidence.name: Designer button
evidence.detail: A pearl cufflink from an exclusive custom suit jacket was found jammed in the safe's hinge.

evidence.name: Coffee stain
evidence.detail: A spilled cup of caramel macchiato dripped across the edge of the master blueprint desk.

evidence.name: Access log
evidence.detail: The digital elevator log shows a restricted override code entered from the basement floor.

evidence.name: Shredded memo
evidence.detail: Fragments of a handwritten resignation letter were discovered in the lobby recycling bin.

revelations: The theft required both the executive safe combination and a timed distraction in the lobby.
The power brownout was triggered intentionally from the internal building management terminal.
At least one alibi completely masks a secret double-life meeting held in the underground parking garage.

endings.culpritsCaught: The confidential contract is recovered from a locked filing cabinet, and the corporate saboteurs are publicly exposed to the board.
endings.culpritsEscape: The morning sun rises, the lockdown lifts, and the culprit slips away into the corporate rush hour traffic with the missing leverage.

dialoguePrompts: Who had a reason to delay the merger, and who benefits if the board never signs?
Ask the person with the strongest alibi to name the last person they saw.
Confront the person connected to the elevator override about the basement log.
Demand that two witnesses compare their stories about the brownout.

tasks.name: Reconstruct the timeline
tasks.detail: Place the brownout, safe override, and elevator entry in the correct order.

tasks.name: Audit the access log
tasks.detail: Match the override credential to a person and identify who could have borrowed it.

tasks.name: Recover the torn memo
tasks.detail: Piece together the resignation fragments and decide who was being threatened.

tasks.name: Protect the contract
tasks.detail: Move the recovered contract to a secure location before the next vote.

conflicts: The CEO claims the safe was never opened, but the access log proves otherwise.
The chief of staff knows the override password but says it was changed last week.
The person with the coffee stain says they never entered the blueprint room.
Two witnesses remember the lobby distraction differently.
secretObjectives: Convince the board to postpone the merger without being identified as the saboteur.
Keep your secret meeting in the parking garage hidden until the final vote.
Make another player look responsible for the brownout.
Find the contract and remove one page before it reaches the board.
twists: The contract was stolen before the brownout, and the blackout was staged to hide the timing.
The resignation letter was written by someone who never intended to resign.
The elevator override was entered by an authorized credential copied from a photo.

cast.name: Kang Tae-mu
cast.personality: a notoriously cold, perfectionist CEO obsessed with efficiency
cast.alibi: Was reviewing quarterly financial spreadsheets in his private corner office.
cast.fact: Tae-mu left his master office key on his desk during the hour of the theft.

cast.name: Shin Ha-ri
cast.personality: a brilliant, overworked senior researcher living a chaotic double life
cast.alibi: Was frantically running food-tasting reports in the corporate cafeteria kitchen.
cast.fact: Ha-ri was seen swapping ID badges with someone in the stairwell.

cast.name: Cha Sung-hoon
cast.personality: a loyal, smooth-talking chief of staff who misses nothing
cast.alibi: Was coordinating security protocols with the night guard team on floor 10.
cast.fact: Sung-hoon knows the exact password to the executive safe override.

cast.name: Jin Young-seo
cast.personality: a rebellious chaebol heiress hiding from an arranged marriage
cast.alibi: Was hiding in the marketing stockroom dodging a phone call from her father.
cast.fact: Young-seo has a spare keycard to the executive elevators.

cast.name: Director Lee
cast.personality: a scheming board member plotting a hostile corporate takeover
cast.alibi: Was smoking a cigar by the emergency exit balcony in the rain.
cast.fact: Director Lee's personal account received a massive anonymous wire transfer.

cast.name: Secretary Gye
cast.personality: a bubbly office gossip who tracks every piece of corporate drama
cast.alibi: Was organizing catering receipts at the main lobby front desk.
cast.fact: Secretary Gye witnessed someone tampering with the fuse box before the lights went out.
